why: Both analyses identify the dead sales force, founder-centric control, missing budgets and bed concentration, and both wrongly rule out implants, but Analysis 2 builds the results-paid specialist sales force into the hedgehog itself and more explicitly treats beds as the cash base with instruments and P&L-owning product units as the future. Analysis 2 is also more candid about its limits, with a stated confidence level, trigger thresholds and an admission that it cannot schedule the re-check, whereas Analysis 1 offers to schedule one despite saying it lacks the tools.
